title: PipelineAnalyzeConciseResponse
description: HEL-914 task 6.4: `GET /api/pipelines/:id/analyze?concise=true`'s opt-in per-node projection -- one entry per ENABLED step, in no particular order, each carrying the runtime graph path (`root:<rootId> > s1 > s4`, design.md D5/R5, the SAME format/implementation `PipelineAnalyzeResponse`'s lane-path error reporting uses), the step's op kind, and its validationError when present. A wholly separate response shape from `PipelineAnalyzeResponse` (schemas/pipelines/pipeline-analyze-response.schema.json) -- absent/false `concise` returns that byte-identical full response instead, never a variant of this one. Bounded by the named byte budget `PipelineAnalyzeConciseResponse.ByteBudget` (design.md D6) on a 12-node/40-column/2-root graph.

path.description: The runtime graph path, e.g. "root:r1 > s1 > s4".

validationError.description: Omitted (not null) when the node has no validation error.
